method: Every cited source_url re-fetched (curl + HTML/PDF text extraction); verbatim quote fuzzy-matched then each claim read in context for meaning, domain trust, organisational vs personal contact, currency/range sanity. Independent missed-info searches on the least-covered tracks (Santiago, Montichiari, Marseille, Bangkok, Galapagar, Anoeta, Juan de Fuca, Loulé, Bourges, plus Roubaix/Pruszków/Büttgen/Tissot). Official sites for Santiago (Cloudflare 403/JS) and Marseille (JS) unreachable; no official missed info for Santiago, Marseille, Bangkok, Galapagar. Convention: no_claim = status with no source, excluded from error rate; error_rate = (rejected+unverifiable)/(total-no_claim).
